title: mnemonica .tactica usages
description: Per-type usage sites (lookups, instantiations, property accesses) of one .tactica source (format version 1.0/1.1). Keys are type names (short names, NOT collection-qualified fullPaths — usages predate the prefix and mnemographica joins them loosely); see tactica/README.md.

version.description: Format version. Absent means 1.0 (pre-versioning and 1.0 outputs are identical in shape).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

usages.description: One entry array per used type, keyed by the name as written at the use site (short names or dotted paths; generators may prefix custom-collection types with their collectionId). A type with no discovered usages simply has no key.

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based, relative to the project root — see tactica/README.md "location".

kind.description: The usage shape, as emitted by generators today: "lookup" (lookup('X')), "instantiation" (new X(...)), "propertyAccess" (X.staticMember or X itself as a value). Open string — readers tolerate values they do not know rather than failing.

code.description: The usage site as source text (may span lines). Never truncated by the generator.

constructorText.description: The constructor expression exactly as written (e.g. "UserEntity" for new UserEntity(...)). Present on instantiation usages only.

holderScopeId.description: The scope holding the use: a file path, or `file:line:col` for function/method scopes — the creation-graph scopeId vocabulary.
